stem: A pharmacy assigns support personnel to receive and process Schedule II stock. Which safeguards apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Use only a personnel category authorized for the assigned step by 247 CMR 8.05.
Permit every technician trainee to receive Schedule II stock independently.
Maintain pharmacist supervision and pharmacist-only professional functions.
Allow a cashier to perform any handling step with manager approval.
Ignore personnel-scope rules because the product is Schedule II.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Use only a personnel category authorized for the assigned step by 247 CMR 8.05. Maintain pharmacist supervision and pharmacist-only professional functions.

choice_analysis.A: Supported: Use only a personnel category authorized for the assigned step by 247 CMR 8.05.
choice_analysis.B: Not supported: Permit every technician trainee to receive Schedule II stock independently.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Maintain pharmacist supervision and pharmacist-only professional functions.
choice_analysis.D: Not supported: Allow a cashier to perform any handling step with manager approval.
choice_analysis.E: Not supported: Ignore personnel-scope rules because the product is Schedule II.

related_facts: Interns and technician categories may handle Schedule II controlled substances only within the specific conditions and supervision requirements of 247 CMR 8.05.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Permit every technician trainee to receive Schedule II stock independently.'

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Schedule II handling by pharmacy support personnel
